'''Repulsor boots''', also called '''Grav boots''' and '''Gravity boots''', were a type of footwear characterized by miniature [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] units inset into the sole of each boot.<ref name="TCSWE" />

Used to maneuver through the air, repulsor boots varied in power and ability, with some models only allowing for hovering off the ground,<ref name="UR" /> while others allowed for limited flight hundreds of meters in the air.<ref name="BHC" />

Repulsor boots were known for being difficult to use, with balance being a considerable issue; an inexperienced user could easily slide and pinwheel out of control,<ref name="BHC" /> and required careful manipulation and positioning of one's feet.<ref name="UR" />
